remarks: Welcome to one of Norwalk's most desirable Townhouse complexes! This rarely available end unit offers the perfect blend of comfort, space, and style. Step inside to find a beautifully designed open floor plan featuring hardwood floors on the main level, a cozy fireplace in the living room, and a stylish breakfast bar that flows seamlessly into the living and dining area. Ideal for both everyday living and entertaining. Sliders open to a private deck overlooking river views, the perfect backdrop for your morning coffee or evening unwind. Upstairs you'll find two generously sized bedrooms, both with soaring cathedral ceilings and ample closet space. The primary suite boasts its own full bath and a private balcony where you can relax in complete privacy. A versatile loft space adds even more flexibility, perfect for a home office, or game room. Additional features include stainless steel appliances, an 1 car attached garage with storage, and plenty of visitor parking. Just minutes from I-95, the Merritt Parkway, local shops, restaurants, and all that Norwalk has to offer.
